title: Envelope_for_AnyValue
description:
Outer wrapper for every `--json` response.

Exactly one of `data` or `error` is present. The `skip_serializing_if` attributes keep the absent field out of the JSON entirely.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision.

version.description: Semver-ish version of this schema, e.g. `"1.0"`.

ErrorCategory.description:
Broad classification bucket for Crab errors.

Serializes to lowercase (`"transient"`, `"conflict"`, and so on) for structured machine-readable error envelopes.

ErrorInfo.description:
Structured error representation for the JSON error envelope.

Populated from a `&CrabError` via the `From` impl. Contains the stable error code, classification, human message, retry hint, variant-specific details, and the `std::error::Error::source()` chain.
